Ons advies: vraag een parkeervergunning: Our advice: apply for a residents' parking permit
U woont in de binnenstad, er staat een a: You live in the city centre, a car is registered in your name and you want to park near your home. Then you are probably eligible for a residents' parking permit.
Wat betekent dit voor u?: What does this mean for you?
Met de vergunning parkeert u in zone Bin: With the permit you park in zone Binnenstad without paying for parking. The permit costs 38,50 euro per year. The city centre sometimes has a waiting list. So apply in good time, for example as soon as you know you are moving.
Heeft uw woning een eigen garage of opri: Does your home have its own garage or driveway? Then you do not get a permit. You can apply for a visitor permit instead.
Aanvragen met DigiD, 38,50 euro per jaar: Apply with DigiD, 38,50 euro per year.
Voor familie, vrienden of een mantelzorg: For family, friends or an informal carer.
If you get a different car later.
